_readme: VA-04 Compliance Agent config. Autonomously generates and signs off the compliance audit trail, replacing the CAB (Change Advisory Board) in the Validate phase. Use this alongside AGENT_CONFIG_INSTRUCTIONS.md to understand how to fill your own agent config.

agent.name: Compliance Agent
agent.description: Replaces CAB — autonomously generates and signs off the compliance audit trail.

behaviour._blocking_note: Any compliance check returning non_compliant blocks the release and halts pipeline progression until remediated.

shared_folder._note: Reads release artefacts produced by the Build phase agents. Policy rules are provided by the Policy DB or passed alongside artefacts.

release_artefacts.description: Release artefacts from the Build phase — code changes, deployment packages, and build outputs subject to compliance evaluation.

policy_rules.description: Compliance policy rules applied to evaluate each release artefact. Sourced from the Policy DB or provided directly alongside the artefacts.

constraints.description: Optional additional compliance constraints or scope exceptions applied during audit evaluation.

compliance_audit_trail.description: One item per compliance check performed against a release artefact.

policy_signoff.description: Aggregated compliance sign-off certifying the release artefacts against all applicable policy rules.

compliance_audit.description: Validates each release artefact against the applicable policy rules and produces a structured compliance check record.

regulatory_mapping.description: Maps each release artefact and change to applicable regulatory frameworks and policy rules from the Policy DB.

audit_trail_generation.description: Generates an immutable, signed audit trail record certifying compliance status across all release artefacts.

compliance_rules_engine.description: Evaluates each release artefact against the policy rules and returns a pass/fail compliance status with supporting evidence.

audit_writer.description: Writes the structured compliance audit trail to the shared output folder and git audit repo.

policy_db.description: Queries the Policy DB to retrieve applicable compliance rules for the current project context and release scope.

signature_service.description: Signs the completed compliance audit trail to certify its integrity and authenticity as a CAB-equivalent sign-off.

freeform_extraction._note: Free-form documents (docx/pdf/html) are parsed for text and then an LLM call extracts structured fields. No fixed template required.

git_reader._enabled_note: false → read from local files under tech_stack.git_reader.local_audit_dir. true → read from the real audit repo via GitPython. Toggle per environment.
git_reader._note: run_id is passed by GenWiz as X-Run-ID header on every agent call. Agent uses it to resolve the path and read previous step output.
